rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notification is a 0.49 ha polygon (regeneration felling, Avesta); no completed felling overlaps it (0%).
No species records inside the polygon or within 250 m; near-site effort is also zero records there (county median within 250 m is 3), so this absence says little.

Two eligible VU site-bound forest species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Goodyera repens (295 m, 2025) and Skeletocutis brevispora (435 m, 2025). Both list lack of dead wood among threats, and the latter also lack of continuity forest and ground disturbance from forestry.

Supporting evidence: NT site-bound fungi Camarops tubulina and Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum recorded 295-454 m away (beyond 250 m, so they do not count toward the 3-species rule). Mobile EN bird Aegolius funereus at 757 m is supporting only.
1000 m effort is adequate (108 records, above county median 66), so rubric hint MEDIUM stands.

uncertainties: Eligible records lie 295 m and 435 m away; whether the species occur in the polygon is unknown.
The polygon has no recorded observations at all, so its own habitat is undescribed by these data.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the felling site
That the site lacks red-listed species
Stand characteristics or habitat quality of the polygon
Anything about legality of the felling
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for habitat relevant to the nearby VU species (dead wood, continuity forest) and consider a field survey before felling starts.
